exposure: BioGlue injection into fetal cisterna magna
cohort: Pregnant ewes (n=9) and their fetuses (n=16) were used, with fetuses divided into an intervention group (n=9) and a control group (n=7).
finding: The ultrasound-guided transuterine approach successfully replicated the BioGlue fetal hydrocephalus model in sheep, achieving consistent and reproducible results with a 100% induction rate after technical modifications.
gest_age: 95 days gestation at the time of intervention
